scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Welcome to Juno Airport where we offer domestic flights to Einbroch, Lighthalzen and Hugel,
and international flights to Izlude and Rachel.
How may I be of service?
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
欢迎来到朱诺机场。我们提供前往艾音布罗克、里希塔乐镇和毁葛的国内航班，以及前往依斯鲁得岛和拉赫的国际航班。
请问有什么可以帮您的？

scripts.text: Board the Airship.
scripts.translation: 搭乘飞空艇

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
The boarding fee for all
flights is 1,200 zeny. If you
use a Free Ticket for Airship,
the boarding fee will be waived.So would you like to depart?
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
所有航班的登船费均为 1,200 泽尼。如果您使用飞空艇免费券，则无需支付登船费。请问您要出发吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have 1,200 zeny to pay
for the boarding fee.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
很抱歉，您的 1,200 泽尼不足以支付登船费。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
谢谢，祝您
生活愉快。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Welcome to Juno Airport. If you've just arrived from your
flight, let me guide you to the main terminal. Otherwise, please
board the departing Airship to reach your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
欢迎来到朱诺机场。如果您是刚下飞机，请让我引导您前往主航站楼。否则，请搭乘出发的飞空艇前往您的目的地。

scripts.text: Exit to main terminal
scripts.translation: 前往主航站楼出口

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Once you're in the main terminal, you must pay the fee once again
to board a departing Airship. You should only exit if your intended
destination is Juno. Proceed to
exit to the main terminal?
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
进入主航站楼后，您必须再次支付费用才能搭乘出发的飞空艇。只有当您的目的地是朱诺时才应选择出口。是否前往主航站楼出口？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Alright, thank you
for your patronage
and I hope you have
a pleasant flight~
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
好的，感谢您的光临，祝您旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[Boarding Staff]
Would you like to board the
Airship that flies to Einbroch,
Lighthalzen and Hugel? If so,
please let me guide you to that
Airship's boarding area.
scripts.translation:
[登船人员]
您想搭乘飞往艾音布罗克、里希塔乐镇和毁葛的飞空艇吗？如果是的话，请让我引导您前往该飞空艇的登船区。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Boarding Staff]
Very well, then.
Thank you for your
patronage, and I hope
you enjoy your travels~
scripts.translation:
[登船人员]
好的。感谢您的光临，祝您旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[Boarding Staff]
Would you like to board
the Airship which flies to
Juno, Izlude and Rachel?
If so, let me guide
you to the boarding area.
scripts.translation:
[登船人员]
您想搭乘飞往朱诺、依斯鲁得岛和拉赫的飞空艇吗？如果是的话，请让我引导您前往登船区。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Boarding Staff]
Alright, then.
Thank you for flying
with us, and I hope you
enjoy your travels on our
state of the art Airships.
scripts.translation:
[登船人员]
好的。感谢您搭乘我们的航班，希望您在我们的先进飞空艇上享受旅程。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome to Juno Airport.
Please use this door to
board the Airship that will
be flying all the way to Izlude
in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom,
and to Rachel in the Arunafeltz
Republic.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎来到朱诺机场。请通过这扇门搭乘飞空艇，它将一路飞往卢恩·米德加兹王国的依斯鲁得岛，以及阿鲁纳菲兹共和国的拉赫。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Otherwise, if Juno is
your intended destination,
please head down the stairs
and ask the Arrival Staff to lead
you to the main terminal. Thank
you, and enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
否则，如果您的目的地是朱诺，请下楼并询问到达区工作人员，由他们引导您前往主航站楼。谢谢，祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome to Juno Airport.
Please use this door to
board the Airship which stops
over Einbroch, Lighthalzen and
Hugel in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎来到朱诺机场。请通过这扇门搭乘飞空艇，它将停靠于修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的艾音布罗克、里希塔乐镇和毁葛。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Otherwise, if Juno is
your intended destination,
please head down the stairs
and ask the Arrival Staff to lead
you to the main terminal. Thank
you, and enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
否则，如果您的目的地是朱诺，请下楼并询问到达区工作人员，由他们引导您前往主航站楼。谢谢，祝您旅途愉快。
